videos.headline: Too early to judge: YouTube Analytics has no data for it yet, and the public counter shows 4 views since 7 Nov, in line with our other long videos.

why.text: 4 views on the public counter about 2.5 days after publishing; our three earlier long videos had 6, 1 and 1 views at 48 hours (median 1).

videos.headline: The McDonald's worker vs CEO Short reached 1,194 views, about six times the Shorts median, with 48.4% staying to watch.

why.text: 1,194 views by the live count at about 48 hours, against a Shorts median of 202 since 25 Oct.
48.4% stayed to watch (median 36.5%) and 54.7% viewed (median 55.9%), on 638 Analytics views.
The steepest fall, 18.5 points, came at 5.3 s on 'And that worker isn't in America. It's a restaurant crew member in Poland.'; 20.9% held after the hook (median 25.5%).
98.6% of views came from the Shorts feed, and 100% of country-tagged views were from the US.
